record.question: The recommended hepatitis B vaccination schedule in CKD/dialysis patients is:
record.explanation: Answer B: 0, 1, 2, 6 months (double dose). For adults receiving hemodialysis, one valid hepatitis B regimen is the four-dose high-dose Engerix-B series at 0, 1, 2, and 6 months. Other licensed dialysis formulations use different valid schedules, so the manufacturer matters. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/hepatitis-b/hcp/vaccine-administration/; https://www2.cdc.gov/vaccines/ed/pinkbook/2024/pb_hepb/PB_HepB.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
